verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses connection health states (expired/revoked links), reconnect/update-mode flows, or any documented status codes for broken links; the pack covers data products (balances, transactions, verification) and onboarding/testing but nothing about repairing or re-authenticating an existing Connect session. missing for 10: documented connection status/error codes for expired or revoked links, an update/reconnect flow API or Connect mode that avoids re-linking from scratch, and any ops-facing guidance on monitoring/repairing broken links.
